text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algerian expatriates begin vote on constitution.

- Authorities pursue campaign for the referendum. Transitional National Council president Abdelkader Bensalah chairs referendum meeting in the western town of Sid Bel Abbes. Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia presides over a rally in Algiers.
- Opposition leaders question the transparency of the referendum.

- University teachers call Universities and Scientific Research Minister Boubakeur Benbouzid a demagogue. Benbouzid has sent the teachers' union a letter saying their claim for more pay was fair but the government had no money to meet it.
- Algerian and Canadian businessmen sign three joint venture projects in Montreal. They are considering more projects in farm and fishing sectors.
- Algerian expatriates vote under police surveillance.
